title: Biguanide AMP-Activated Protein Kinase Activation in Cellular Senescence
pre_discovery_prompt: First-line oral anti-diabetic biguanide therapy extends healthy lifespan in animal models and lowers all-cause mortality in diabetic humans beyond non-diabetic controls. What metabolic nutrient-sensing cascade is responsible?
ground_truth_finding: Mild inhibition of mitochondrial complex I resulting in elevated AMP/ATP ratio, triggering AMPK activation and downstream mTORC1 inhibition.
notes_on_reconstruction: Stripped Metformin drug name and specific trial names.
